text:
rajesh.partner: Quick heads-up  partner-run POC with Meridian next Tue 11am PT. Need a compact checklist for provisioning, entitlement mapping, and a sample SLA they can sign off on before kickoff. Who can own?

claire.sales: I'll own pricing + SLA language. Core ask: steady 120 rps, peaks ~420 rps for 10-15min spikes. They want a burst credit pool in the quote.

omar.eng: We can spin a tenant in us-west-2. Need their SAML metadata, partner CIDRs, and whether they require IP allowlist-only or will permit an outbound tunnel. Also confirm if they want auto-fallback routing when the dedicated pool is saturated.

maria.solutions: I'll draft the runbook: provisioning steps, SSO exchange, entitlement->token mapping, warmup commands, and an incident triage checklist. Will include Console screenshots and a short curl example to exercise KV cache.

kevin.security: Meridian's questionnaire hit two blockers: BYOK for hosted, and DR compliance (they require 7-day RPO within EU). Hosted BYOK is in roadmap but not available GA; Private supports HSM. For DR we can offer multi-region failover with warm replicas but need legal to agree on RPO terms.

rajesh.partner: They also asked for per-route cost visibility and a webhook for anomalous token burn alerts. Can we provide that in the pilot?

omar.eng: Console exposes per-route token counters; we can create a webhook alert for token_rate > baseline*4. I'll add an alert expression to the runbook.

maria.solutions: Warmup snippet I'll include:
```
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TK" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-lite-v1","prompt":"warmup"}' &
done
```
This primes kernels and KV cache.

claire.sales: Pricing note: pilot (90d) -> metered w/ one-time setup fee; 12mo commit -> discounted dedicated rate + monthly burst credits. I'll post scenarios to SFDC opp/11009.

kevin.security: I'll assemble answers for the sec questionnaire: encryption at rest (AES-256), TLS for transit, audit log retention options (30/90/365), and access controls (RBAC + SAML groups). Flagging BYOK as Legal/Product dependency.

infra-bot: tenant-provisioner triggered: meridian-staging -> queued, expected done in ~6m.

rajesh.partner: Timeline recap: Claire finalizes pricing & SLA today, Maria drafts runbook + alert hooks, Omar will provision and validate SSO once we get metadata, Kevin completes sec responses. Ping me when tenant is ready so Meridian can run their smoke tests.

omar.eng: On it  will request SAML and CIDRs in DM. If partner can't open outbound, we can provide a temporary reverse-proxy endpoint but will need approval on logging retention.

maria.solutions: Adding a short troubleshooting section for token exhaustion, SSO cert rotation, and model-fallback quality checks. Will link doc in ~2 hours.

claire.sales: Putting a soft expectation in the AE deck that BYOK is "planned" not guaranteed for pilot. Legal is on standby for any MSA addendum.

rajesh.partner: Great. Thanks team  will loop in Meridian once you confirm the tenant + runbook. :thumbsup:
